note: Canonical crisis data for the whole product. agents/config/crisis_resources.json is a byte-identical copy, and tests/crisis-resources.test.ts fails if the two drift. Order shown to a member is emergency, then crisis, then health: a general health line must never sit above the suicide-prevention line, even when it is the one open at 4 AM. Re-verify every number against its own source before any production launch: a stale crisis number is worse than none.
